scripts.build:executor: bun run build:wf && bun run --cwd packages/wfkit-executor build
scripts.build:cli: bun run build:executor && bun run --cwd apps/cli build
scripts.build:docs: cd apps/docs && uv run --no-project --with-requirements requirements.txt mkdocs build
scripts.build:site: bun run build:marketing && bun run build:docs
scripts.serve:control-plane: bun run build:control-plane && INTEGRATIONS_WEB_DIR="$PWD/apps/integrations/web/dist" bun run apps/integrations/cli/src/main.ts serve
scripts.refresh:control-plane: bun run build:control-plane && bun run dashboard:control-plane
scripts.example:approval: cd examples/approval && bun run main.ts demo
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run example:order-saga && bun run example:approval && bun run build && bun run build:control-plane && bun run build:site && bun run build:cli
